sources.title: Digital Paper and Digital Paper App support termination notice
facts: Sony ended repair and support for DPT-RP1 and DPT-CP1 on March 31, 2026.
Sony ended provision of the Digital Paper App and device firmware with that support.

sources.title: DPT-RP1/DPT-CP1 Help Guide: Transferring a document from a computer
facts: Only PDF files can be transferred.
Maximum transfer size is 1 GB per file.

sources.title: Digital Paper App update history: version 1.4.7.01202
facts: Sony documented separate Windows and macOS versions of the Digital Paper App.
The official application material does not list a Linux version.

sources.title: DPT-RP1/DPT-CP1 Help Guide: Specifications
facts: DPT-RP1 and DPT-CP1 support PDF documents.
The published guide describes firmware version 1.6.

sources.title: QUADERNO support and manuals
facts: The support matrix lists Gen.1, Gen.2, and Gen.3C families.
Gen.3C protocol compatibility is not documented and remains unverified.
